I think that there is some dichotomy on the issue. Going into ''Tel'aran'riod'' in the flesh would allow you to bring things into and out of that realm. As for Birgitte's arrow, it was most likely ripped out of the Dream World along with Birgitte by Moghedien. Aside from those special circumstances, one couldn't, while in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', take something they created there into the real world.
